description: Attach (or replace) the receipt image or PDF on an existing Splitwise expense. Changes nothing else on the expense — cost, split and description are not sent. Pass the file as receipt.base64. Fails if Splitwise does not store the file. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

expense_id.description: ID of the expense to attach the receipt to

receipt.description: Receipt to attach: PNG, JPEG, GIF or PDF, up to 10 MiB. Give exactly one of base64 or path. The type is detected from the file contents. Replaces any receipt already on the expense.

base64.description: The file bytes, base64-encoded (a data: URL prefix is accepted and stripped). The normal way to pass a receipt.

filename.description: Name to store the file under, e.g. "receipt.pdf".

mime_type.description: Optional. If given, it must match the type detected from the file contents.

path.description: A file inside SPLITWISE_INPUT_DIR on the machine running this server (relative to it, or absolute). Only works when that variable is set — never on a hosted server; use base64 there.

name: sw_attach_receipt
